implementation_constraints: The accepted default path must remain unchanged unless all correctness and strict cold gates pass.
The current one-stream helper is CPU-backend and does not retain a reusable GPU gate tensor; sparse-graph-probe-validation already rejected using it for graph zero-transfer.

The existing DS4_HOT manager is not acceptable for this profile because pair_count=64 inflates ideal 544 MiB up/down payload to 2507.5 MiB up/down-only or 3761.25 MiB gate/up/down, with estimated gate-cache penalty above 1.0-2.0 s.

A compact sparse implementation must avoid per-layer dummy-slot inflation and must account for gate output: either transfer selected gate output vectors to GPU, or recompute gate with compact gate/up/down payload and include the extra kernel/payload cost.

MMVQ is not bit-exact versus CPU fallback. The earlier compare-only probe was token-stable only because CPU fallback remained authoritative. Any write/skip mode must pass a fixed-text top1 gate before a France performance run.

next_allowed_source_probe.scope: default-off diagnostic/proof only, not a strict cold SOTA benchmark
next_allowed_source_probe.candidate: compact sparse fused MMVQ hot-pair probe for complete (layer, expert) up/down pairs, starting with pair_count=48
code_paths_to_change: src/models/deepseek4.cpp::build_expert_mix for compact sparse hot branch or proof hook
ggml/src/ggml-cuda/moe_stream.cu MMVQ resident hot-pair kernel/probe helpers
ggml/src/ggml-cpu/ggml-cpu.c only if a default-off compare/write hook is needed at mul_mat_id boundary
first_probe_requirements: Default-off build passes and default-off fixed-text llama-results remains same_top1 == n_tokens.
Probe mode must not write logits or clear CPU fallback counts.
Record exact selected pair profile, payload MiB, gate-output transfer/recompute path, H2D/D2H bytes, kernel ms, scatter/combine copies, and cgroup memory including page cache.
If op-level error is nonzero, add a separate write/skip fixed-text top1 run before any strict cold generation benchmark.
Do not run strict cold France performance benchmark until fixed-text top1 passes under write/skip mode and projected overhead remains below the corrected margin.

strict_sota_gate_if_later_promoted.correctness: France answer must be semantic, coherent, and complete; five-prompt semantic set required before calling prompt-general steady behavior stable.
strict_sota_gate_if_later_promoted.push_policy: If a compliant new SOTA appears, immediately record full reproduction metadata, commit, push to ssd/vendor/deepseek-token-rate-16gb, then clean pushed-source reproduce before promotion.

decision.source_edit_gate: Only the default-off compact sparse fused MMVQ proof/compare probe is allowed. No logit-writing performance run and no DS4_HOT dense-manager adaptation are allowed from this artifact alone.
decision.reason: After the refreshed bottleneck, the corrected compact CPU-backend fused bound remains above 10 tok/s with about 878 ms margin even after selected gate-output H2D. This is enough to justify a default-off correctness/dataflow probe, but not enough to promote or benchmark without proving token stability and compact sparse placement.
